research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Crossbeam is researching systems and methods of determining partner influence and systems and methods of contextual record reporting to support ecosystem led growth. The work focuses on receiving and analyzing activity and population data across partners, identifying overlapping records, and quantifying how partner interactions influence accounts. Together, these efforts advance influence attribution and contextual data reporting within partner ecosystems.

product.name: Crossbeam Ecosystem Revenue Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables companies to securely share and analyze CRM data with partners to identify mutual customers, prospects, and opportunities for revenue growth.

product.name: Crossbeam for Sales
product.description: A sales enablement solution that delivers ecosystem insights and co-selling tools within CRM platforms and sales tools to help sales teams identify and act on partner-related opportunities.

product.name: Crossbeam Integrations and Data Connectors
product.description: A set of integrations and connectors that sync data from various sources and push ecosystem insights into sales, marketing, and analytics tools.

identifier.value: Crossbeam Account Mapping and Overlap Analysis

product.name: Crossbeam Account Mapping and Overlap Analysis
product.description: A feature that compares partner data to identify overlapping accounts, prospects, and opportunities for joint business actions.

product.name: Crossbeam Performance Dashboard and Attribution
product.description: A tool to measure and attribute partner-sourced and influenced revenue, providing insights into the ROI of ecosystem strategies.
